test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 30

questions.question: An article is sold at a profit of 28%. If the cost price is increased by ₹75 and the selling price is reduced by ₹70, then the profit would be 26.4%. What is the original cost price (in ₹) of the article?
The diagonals of a rhombus are 66 cm and 36 cm, respectively. The area of the rhombus (in cm2) is:
A man sells two articles for ₹6,000 each. He gains 20% on the first but loses 25% on the next. His total loss percentage (in %), approximately, will be:
Ravi, Kishan, Surya invests ₹50,000 in a business. Ravi invests ₹4,000 more than Kishan and Kishan invests ₹5,000 more than Surya. Out of a total profit of ₹1,35,000, Ravi's share (in ₹) is:

Which of the following numbers is divisible by 82?

These trains cross each other completely in 10 seconds, when travelling in opposite directions. How much time (in seconds) does train A take to cross a tunnel that is 450 m long?

A trader fixes the marked price of an article as ₹3,000. He sells it to the customers at a discount of 25%. Further, he gives a discount of 10% for cash payment. If the cost price of the article is ₹2,000, find his gain or loss percentage on the sale of the article.
